state: Goal `core-time-datetime` is met: all 17 `Core\Time\DateTime` members have every feature proof, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Time\DateTime'` prints nothing owed, 51 examples and 17 hostile cases green. The last four members, `with`, `withTime`, `startOf` and `endOf`, landed this session with their Rust tests, their `covers:` on the builders `.nvst`, and perf figures for all three `Core\Time` groups. Writing the `endOf` attack found a bug, and it is fixed: at the last representable second, `endOf` threw for every unit from `Second` up because the next unit's start was past the range. It now finds the last instant on the civil fields (`nvs_core_time_datetime_end_of`'s doc says how), pinned from Rust and by the builders `.nvst`. `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes` and `bun nv playbook --closes` are clean for this goal. Nothing is blocked.
